headline: US Approves First Seabed Mineral Exploration Lease Off American Samoa
summary: The US government issued its first seabed mining lease offshore American Samoa, drawing criticism from local officials and environmentalists citing Endangered Species Act concerns.
why: Deep-sea mineral exploration holds potential supplies of critical battery metals like cobalt and nickel, but faces mounting environmental and regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Seabed Mining
impacts.why: The grant of an offshore seabed lease opens federal waters to critical mineral seabed exploration.
